“And she took me for you,” Francis mused, glimpsing the situation. “I don’t blame you for losing your temper, though you must admit it’s a nasty one. Wanted to cut off my ears yesterday, didn’t you?”

“It’s the old Morgan temper,” Henry said. “He was by all the accounts a peppery old cuss.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u005-r0036", "tag": "p", "text": "“No more peppery than those Solanos you’re marrying into. Why, most of the family came down on the beach and peppered me with rifles on my departing way. And your Leoncia pulled her little popgun on a long-bearded old fellow who might have been her father and gave him to understand she’d shoot him full of holes if he didn’t stop plugging away at me.”", "sha256": "3db34f418a4c745afed65789e9d3612cffe92775b4059390c21e1c206cb76906", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[264]", "source_html": "

“Was, I said,” Henry nodded. “He isn’t now. His name was Alfaro Solano, and he had some temper himself. They claim to be descended from the Spanish conquistadores, and they are prouder than hornets. ", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u005-r0045", "tag": "p", "text": "“Next, up at Bocas del Toro, a messenger from Leoncia delivered back the engagement ring. And there you are.
